requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: What the applicant was accused of
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: What the applicant was accused of
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed legal-design registry requires the accusation and the platform holds no case-specific offense wording
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the accusation exactly as the arrest record describes it

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed legal-design registry requires the arrest date and the platform holds no case-specific arrest date
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arrest date exactly as the arrest record states it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Agency incident, booking, or arrest number, if the record assigns one
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Agency incident, booking, or arrest number, if the record assigns one
requiredBeforeFiling.why: a record number is case-specific and must be copied from the applicant's own arrest record rather than guessed
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the incident, booking, or arrest number shown on the arrest record, if one exists

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed legal-design registry asks which agency made the arrest and the platform holds no case-specific agency
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that made the arrest, copied from the arrest record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Why the arrest was contrary to law or by mistake
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Why the arrest was contrary to law or by mistake
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed legal-design registry requires this account and the platform holds no case-specific narrative
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the facts, in the applicant's own words and grounded in the record, showing why the arrest was contrary to law or by mistake

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date and result of the endorsement contact
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date and result of the endorsement contact
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the contact result is an applicant event that the route cannot determine
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the contact date and what the agency or State Attorney office said about considering or providing the endorsement

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Office contacted about the required written endorsement
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Office contacted about the required written endorsement
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed legal-design registry requires the agency contact and the platform holds no case-specific contact result
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arresting agency or State Attorney office contacted about endorsement
